name: Monocle of the Fastidious Craftsman
body:
Price 1,250 gp; Aura faint divination; CL 1; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This fine golden monocle is fastened to the collar with an intricate decorative chain. If you are wearing the monocle it allows you to cast detect magic at will as a move action. When using the monocle to examine a magic item, if you have at least 5 ranks in Spellcraft, you may spend one full minute to cast identify from the monocle. This ability functions once per day plus one additional time per day for every 3 ranks in Spellcraft you possess.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 625 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, detect magic, identify
